{{Quote|It's made for stabbing. Bleeds someone out very efficiently.''"<br />"''Why have a flute that's a weapon?''"<br />"''Maybe we just don't like music critics.|[[Wad'e Tay'haai]] and [[Bardan Jusik]], discussing a ''bes'bev''|<ref name="ImpCom501st" />}}
A '''''bes'bev''''' was a traditional [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Flute/Legends|flute]]. Forged from [[Beskar/Legends|''beskar'']] [[Iron/Legends|iron]], a ''bes'bev'' was a combination of musical instrument and [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]]. At one end, a ''bes'bev'' was cut to a sharp tip, similar to a quill [[Stylus/Legends|stylus]], and this bladed end made the instrument ideal for stabbing and drawing [[Blood/Legends|blood]]. A ''bes'bev'' was also hard and sturdy, and could be hefted as a [[Club/Legends|club]] should the need arise.<ref name="ImpCom501st" />

By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="O66" /> the Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Wad'e Tay'haai]] had come into possession of an ancient ''bes'bev''. Tay'haai's flute was [[Color/Legends|colored]] the same dark violet as the plates of his [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]],<ref name="ImpCom501st" /> and he took to carrying the instrument on his [[Utility belt/Legends|belt]].<ref name="O66" /> Tay'haai was a skilled ''bes'bev'' [[Musician/Legends|musician]], and knew how to play a number of [[Music/Legends|songs]] with the instrument, including the traditional tune ''[[Vode An]]''. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], at [[Kyrimorut/Legends|the home]] of his former ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]'' contemporary [[Kal Skirata]], Tay'haai performed for the [[Clan Skirata|Skirata clan]], and encouraged Skirata's [[Gai bal manda|adopted]] son [[Bardan Jusik]] to give his ''bes'bev'' a try.<ref name="ImpCom501st" />

During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the underground musical group known as [[Boba Fett and the Assassin Droids]] came into possession of a ''bes'bev'', incorporating the instrument into their performances. While on a promotional tour for the release of their first album, the group came to blows with their opening act, fellow band [[Dead Rebels]]. In the midst of Dead Rebels' rendition of "[[Death Star Diva]]," their lead [[Musician/Legends|singer]] was struck and rendered unconscious with the ''bes'bev'' by a member of [[Boba Fett and the Assassin Droids]].<ref name="Slugthrowers">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-part-2|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ''bes'bev'' was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' novel [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']], [[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[September 16]], [[2008]].<ref name="O66" /> The Mandalorian instrument appeared again in Traviss' subsequent novel, ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''.<ref name="ImpCom501st" /> In [[2014]], a ''bes'bev'' was mentioned in [[Edward M. Erdelac|Edward Erdelac's]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] entry ''[[Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away]]''.<ref name="Slugthrowers" />
